info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Consumer Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Consumer Investment Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information on consumer investment services by a specified parameter. This endpoint primarily serves financial institutions and developers looking to gather insights on consumer investment products based on unique identifiers. It facilitates data retrieval, enabling stakeholders to make informed decisions regarding investment offerings. Typical use cases include integrating investment service data into applications or analytic systems to enhance consumer engagement.

get.summary: Retrieve consumer investment details by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch details of a specific consumer investment using its unique identifier (RES-100045). It provides key information about the investment, helping consumers understand their options better.
